title: Father and Child in Pajamas Opening Gifts, 1960s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white vintage snapshot depicting a father and his young child in patterned pajamas opening gifts together at home. The father wears classic mid-century horn-rimmed glasses while looking down as the toddler kneels nearby holding a toy card alongside scattered wrapping ribbon. The photo features deckled borders characteristic of early 1960s home photography prints.
